facts: Dogs have three eyelids. The third lid, called a nictitating membrane or "haw," keeps the eye lubricated and protected.
Toto in The Wizard of Oz was played by a female Cairn Terrier named Terry.
Boxers are so named because of their manner of playing using their front paws.
The Basenji is the only barkless dog.
Dogs have a unique way of showing affection, called a "butt wag," where they wag their tail and wiggle their rear end.
